Ben / Jasmine / Marissa — I completed an initial review against our trial abuse signals. Summary:

- Evidence of repeated top-up requests from at least two distinct disposable-style handles tied to the same org domain (quantumfoundry.ai).
- Cross-check with IPs shows activity coming from three distinct ASN ranges; two align with known cloud provider pools often used for parallelized testing.
- Recent usage traces include high-volume, uniform prompt patterns consistent with batch synthetic traffic rather than human exploratory testing.

Recommendation:
- Do not approve an open-ended extension.
- Offer a constrained emergency credit (1,000 credits) for one week with monitoring enabled and require procurement PO or an org verification call for any further extension/replenishment.
- Place a temporary soft flag on the account to require manual approval for subsequent top-ups.

If sales wants to escalate for enterprise conversion, provide procurement evidence (PO) and we can convert to a paid pilot with reserved capacity and appropriate SLA.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
